ccxt.note: The Norynta facade is dependency-free and is checked against CCXT-style method and payload fixtures.

hummingbot.note: Snapshot content is checked without installing Hummingbot's full source environment.

freqtrade.note: OHLCV exports and the starter strategy are compiled; no native live exchange is claimed.

nautilustrader.note: Quote-tick records are a custom-data bridge and are sequence-tested in the SDK.

lean.note: The Python custom-data class is compiled; LEAN's .NET engine is not installed in Python SDK CI.

vnpy.note: BarData-compatible records are unit-tested and the optional native example is compiled.

qlib.note: The feature-frame contract is tested without forcing Qlib's training environment into the SDK.

finrl.note: The dataset contract is tested without forcing FinRL's training stack into the SDK.

jesse.note: Candle order and the starter strategy are checked; no native live exchange is claimed.

openbb.note: EquityHistoricalData-compatible records and a provider starter are compiled without pulling OpenBB's full platform dependency graph into SDK CI.

lumibot.note: The PandasData-compatible frame is tested as a backtest and paper-data bridge; it is not advertised as a native live broker.

quantstats.note: The UTC decimal-return series contract is tested without coupling the SDK to report-rendering dependencies.

tensortrade.note: Deterministic feature rows are suitable for DataFeed Stream sources; Norynta does not claim a live execution service.

zipline.note: Bundle-ingest OHLCV rows include required corporate-action defaults and are compiled independently of Zipline's platform-specific runtime.

octobot.note: Historical candle arrays support research, backtesting, and paper workflows; no native live exchange plugin is claimed.
